description: Link Building Tool: add one prospect domain/page to a project's list. FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION. White-hat scope: contact fields are plain manually-typed free text — NEVER auto-scraped or guessed. New prospects start at status 'prospected'; use update_link_prospect_status to move them through the pipeline.

note.description: Optional first activity-log entry, e.g. 'Found via competitor backlink profile.'

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

targetUrl.description: The project's OWN page this outreach is trying to get linked.

url.description: Optional specific page on domain, a full absolute URL.

name: add_link_prospect
